privateKey.desc: The private key for used by the crypto module to create signed tokens or encrypt data.

queues.copilot.desc: The config for copilot job queue

queues.calendar.desc: The config for calendar job queue

queues.doc.desc: The config for doc job queue

queues.indexer.desc: The config for indexer job queue

queues.notification.desc: The config for notification job queue

queues.backendRuntime.desc: The config for backend runtime job queue

queues.inviteAbuse.desc: The config for invite abuse disposition job queue

throttlers.default.desc: The config for the default throttler.

throttlers.strict.desc: The config for the strict throttler.

allowSignupForOauth.desc: Whether allow new registrations via configured oauth.

requireEmailDomainVerification.desc: Whether require email domain record verification before accessing restricted resources.

requireEmailVerification.desc: Whether require email verification before accessing restricted resources(not implemented).

newAccountShareActionDelay.desc: Minimum account age in seconds before new accounts can invite members or create share links.

trustedCloudflareHeaders.desc: Whether request abuse source facts should trust Cloudflare headers from the origin edge.

inviteQuotaShadowMode.desc: Whether workspace invite quota should record would-block decisions without rejecting requests or executing abuse actions.

inviteQuotaFailOpenOnRuntimeError.desc: Whether workspace invite quota should fail open when native runtime admission is unavailable. Keep disabled for production.

passwordRequirements.desc: The password strength requirements when set new password.

session.ttl.desc: Application auth expiration time in seconds.

session.ttr.desc: Application auth time to refresh in seconds.

token.accessTokenTtl.desc: Access JWT expiration time in seconds.

token.refreshIdleTtl.desc: Auth refresh session inactivity expiration in seconds.

token.refreshAbsoluteTtl.desc: Auth refresh session absolute expiration in seconds.

token.refreshGracePeriod.desc: One-use refresh rotation concurrency grace period in seconds.

token.refreshRetention.desc: Retention for expired auth refresh generations in seconds.

SMTP.name.desc: Hostname used for SMTP HELO/EHLO (e.g. mail.example.com). Leave empty to use the system hostname.

SMTP.host.desc: Host of the email server (e.g. smtp.gmail.com)

SMTP.port.desc: Port of the email server (they commonly are 25, 465 or 587)

SMTP.username.desc: Username used to authenticate the email server

SMTP.password.desc: Password used to authenticate the email server

SMTP.sender.desc: Sender of all the emails (e.g. "LocalMind Self Hosted <noreply@example.com>")

SMTP.ignoreTLS.desc: Whether ignore email server's TLS certificate verification. Enable it for self-signed certificates.

fallbackDomains.desc: The emails from these domains are always sent using the fallback SMTP server.

deliveryWorker.batchSize.desc: Number of mail delivery rows claimed by each worker tick.

deliveryWorker.leaseMs.desc: Mail delivery worker lease duration in milliseconds.

deliveryWorker.retentionDays.desc: Days to retain anonymized terminal mail delivery ledger rows.

fallbackSMTP.name.desc: Hostname used for fallback SMTP HELO/EHLO (e.g. mail.example.com). Leave empty to use the system hostname.

fallbackSMTP.host.desc: Host of the email server (e.g. smtp.gmail.com)

fallbackSMTP.port.desc: Port of the email server (they commonly are 25, 465 or 587)

fallbackSMTP.username.desc: Username used to authenticate the email server

fallbackSMTP.password.desc: Password used to authenticate the email server

fallbackSMTP.sender.desc: Sender of all the emails (e.g. "LocalMind Self Hosted <noreply@example.com>")

fallbackSMTP.ignoreTLS.desc: Whether ignore email server's TLS certificate verification. Enable it for self-signed certificates.

experimental.yocto.desc: Use `y-octo` to merge updates at the same time when merging using Yjs.

history.interval.desc: The minimum time interval in milliseconds of creating a new history snapshot when doc get updated.

avatar.publicPath.desc: The public accessible path prefix for user avatars.

avatar.storage.desc: The config of storage for user avatars.

blob.storage.desc: The config of storage for all uploaded blobs(images, videos, etc.).

transports.desc: The enabled transports for accepting websocket traffics.

maxHttpBufferSize.desc: How many bytes or characters a message can be, before closing the session (to avoid DoS).

name.desc: A recognizable name for the server. It will be shown when connected with LocalMind Desktop.

externalUrl.desc:
Base URL of the LocalMind server, used for generating external URLs.
Defaults to `[server.protocol]://[server.host][:server.port]` if not specified.

https.desc: Whether the server is hosted on a ssl enabled domain (https://).

hosts.desc: Multiple hosts the server will accept requests from.

listenAddr.desc: The address to listen on (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for IPv4, :: for IPv6).

port.desc: Which port the server will listen on.

path.desc: Subpath where the server is deployed, if any (e.g. /localmind).

allowGuestDemoWorkspace.desc: Whether allow guest users to create demo workspaces.

endpoint.desc: The endpoint of the doc service.

enabled.desc: Enable permission-checked scanned PDF OCR through the server-controlled SparkClaw endpoint.

baseUrl.desc: OpenAI-compatible SparkClaw OCR base URL. The server appends /chat/completions.

allowedHost.desc: Exact hostname allowed for outbound OCR requests.

model.desc: Model id sent to the OpenAI-compatible OCR endpoint.

apiKey.desc: Optional server-only bearer token for the OCR endpoint.

timeoutMs.desc: Maximum time for one OCR page inference.

maxUploadBytes.desc: Maximum rasterized page image size accepted by the OCR API.

maxOutputBytes.desc: Maximum cleaned Markdown bytes accepted from one OCR completion.

maxTokens.desc: Maximum completion tokens requested from the OCR model.

maxConcurrency.desc: Maximum concurrent OCR page requests per LocalMind server process.

enabled.desc: Enable the LocalMind SparkClaw ISCP integration

controllerUrl.desc: Internal URL of the LocalMind ISCP controller

controllerToken.desc: Bearer token used between LocalMind and the ISCP controller

domainId.desc: ISCP domain assigned to LocalMind SparkClaw endpoints

ga4.measurementId.desc: GA4 Measurement ID for Measurement Protocol.

ga4.apiSecret.desc: GA4 API secret for Measurement Protocol.

versionControl.enabled.desc: Whether check version of client before accessing the server.

versionControl.requiredVersion.desc: Allowed version range of the app that allowed to access the server. Requires 'client/versionControl.enabled' to be true to take effect.

enabled.desc: Check captcha challenge when user authenticating the app.

config.desc: The config for the captcha plugin.

enabled.desc:
Whether to enable LocalMind AI.
Documentation: LocalMind AI deployment guide

byok.enabled.desc: Allow instance administrators to manage AI provider credentials by workspace through Admin AI.

byok.allowedProviders.desc: AI providers that instance administrators may assign to workspaces through Admin AI.

byok.allowCustomEndpoint.desc: Allow administrator-managed workspace AI credentials to use a custom provider endpoint.

byok.allowPrivateEndpoint.desc: Whether administrator-managed workspace AI custom endpoints may resolve to private network targets. Enable only for trusted provider endpoints.

providers.profiles.desc: The profile list for copilot providers.

providers.defaults.desc: The default provider ids for model output types and global fallback.

providers.routePolicy.desc: Config-driven provider route policy. Supports provider allow/block lists plus cloud/private_cloud/local privacy filters and preferences globally, per feature, or per workspace.

prompts.overrides.desc: Config-driven prompt metadata overrides. Built-in prompt messages remain native fallback unless a later Prompt Registry layer replaces them.

prompts.defaults.desc: Global prompt model defaults for self-hosted deployments. The text bucket applies to text-like prompts, image/transcript apply to prompt category matches, and structured only applies to explicitly included structured prompts. Prompt overrides remain the more specific policy.

tasks.models.desc: Optional task model aliases for embedding, workspace indexing, and rerank. Leave empty to let provider defaults and modelDefinitions choose task routes.

supportBundles.objectStorageWebhooks.desc: Production object-storage webhooks for support bundle direct-download completion notifications. Each entry verifies raw webhook bodies with HMAC-SHA256 before forwarding provider event evidence into the durable transfer queue.

externalMcp.endpoint.desc: The exact server-controlled SparkClaw Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Workspace clients can view but cannot change this URL.

enterpriseCli.enabled.desc: Enable user-scoped enterprise CLI connectors for WeCom, Lark, and DingTalk.

enterpriseCli.allowedProviders.desc: Enterprise CLI providers that users may connect. Instance administrators own this allowlist.

enterpriseCli.allowedToolsByProvider.desc: Exact Enterprise CLI tool names that LocalMind AI may use for each provider. Use * only when the instance administrator explicitly accepts the full discovered catalog.

enterpriseCli.rootDir.desc: Server-controlled root directory for isolated enterprise CLI profiles.

enterpriseCli.binaries.wecom.desc: Server-controlled WeCom CLI binary path or executable name.

enterpriseCli.binaries.lark.desc: Server-controlled Lark CLI binary path or executable name.

enterpriseCli.binaries.dingtalk.desc: Server-controlled DingTalk Workspace CLI binary path or executable name.

mcpDelegation.callbackAllowedOrigins.desc: Exact callback origins that may use HTTP or private network targets for LocalMind MCP delegation events. Keep empty unless a trusted local caller such as SparkClaw requires it.

providers.openai.desc: The config for the openai provider.

providers.openaiCompatible.desc: The config for OpenAI-compatible endpoints such as OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM and LocalAI.

providers.cloudflareWorkersAi.desc: The config for the Cloudflare Workers AI provider.

providers.fal.desc: The config for the fal provider.

providers.gemini.desc: The config for the gemini provider.

providers.geminiVertex.desc: The config for the gemini provider in Google Vertex AI.

providers.anthropic.desc: The config for the anthropic provider.

providers.anthropicVertex.desc: The config for the anthropic provider in Google Vertex AI.

unsplash.desc: The config for the unsplash key.

exa.desc: The config for the exa web search key.

storage.desc: The config for the storage provider.

provider.password.desc: Indexer search service auth password, if not set, basic auth will be disabled. Optional for elasticsearch

showLifetimePrice.desc: Whether enable lifetime price and allow user to pay for it.
